submissions.description: Take a checkout basket to a paid, fulfilled order using Stripe Invoicing. Create the customer and invoice, finalize, collect payment (card or a partner's financing), wait for invoice.paid, then ship. Large orders need a manager's approval before shipping.

evidence.audit_log: every decision with actor, time, inputs hash

exceptions.action: fall back to card payment (A5); keep the finalized invoice
send invoice for card payment; note financing as expired
offer another attempt; after 2 failures send invoice by email
cancel shipment if not dispatched; else collect by card

handoffs.purpose: Ask the lender to finance the finalized basket for this customer.

true.authorized: mark the invoice paid out of band (finance_controller rule), continue to A6 as paid
true.declined: fall back to A5 card payment

handoffs.purpose: Tell the lender the order shipped so the financing activates.

nodes.confidential_notes: Customer IDs are reused across orders; never expose the ID.
nodes.name: create_customer

obligation.reason: Stripe requires a Customer to invoice

nodes.text: create_customer: Create the Stripe Customer with name and email. This is a billing record, not an identity check.

nodes.name: create_invoice
nodes.text: create_invoice: Create the invoice with collection_method=send_invoice and days_until_due=30.

nodes.name: add_items
nodes.text: add_items: One invoice item per basket line. Stripe caps an invoice at 250 items.

nodes.name: finalize_invoice

obligation.reason: amounts must be locked before any payment

nodes.text: finalize_invoice: After this the amounts cannot change. This is the point where a financing partner can be asked to cover the total.

nodes.name: collect_payment
nodes.text: collect_payment: Card payment through the Payment Element, or send the invoice for later payment. Also the fallback when a financing partner declines.

nodes.name: await_invoice_paid
nodes.text: await_invoice_paid: Never ship before invoice.paid. On invoice.payment_failed, offer another attempt.

nodes.name: approve_large_order
nodes.text: approve_large_order: Orders of USD 10,000 or more need a manager's approval before shipping. Company policy, not negotiable.

nodes.name: fulfil_order
nodes.text: fulfil_order: Create the shipment. If the order was financed, tell the partner the order is fulfilled so the loan activates.

nodes.name: T_fulfilled
nodes.text: T_fulfilled: terminal outcome fulfilled

nodes.name: T_cancelled_unpaid
nodes.text: T_cancelled_unpaid: terminal outcome cancelled_unpaid

transitions.pitfalls: Stripe caps an invoice at 250 items.
After this the amounts cannot change.

submissions.description: Check eligibility for a BNPL loan on a merchant's basket, present terms, create the customer, initiate and authorize the loan, return the finalized payment plan, and activate the loan when the merchant reports fulfilment.

evidence.audit_log: every decision with actor, time, inputs hash

exceptions.action: hold transaction 24h, then expire; report declined to merchant
reject activation; ask merchant to collect by other means
expire authorized plan after 14 days; notify merchant

handoffs.purpose: Receive the basket and customer details to run eligibility.
Activate the loan once the merchant reports the order fulfilled.

nodes.name: checkLoanCanBeProvided
nodes.text: checkLoanCanBeProvided: Call the BNPL API to filter the basket for products qualifying for checkout loans. Pass in the array of products from the workflow input as the payload for the API call. Act on the response payload: - If a list of qualifying products is returned then submit customer choices. - If the list of qualifying products is empty then end the workflow

nodes.confidential_notes: Terms vary by risk band; bands are confidential.
nodes.name: getCustomerTermsAndConditions
nodes.text: getCustomerTermsAndConditions: Get the terms and conditions for the BNPL loans. This is static data and therefore has no arguments. The data will be displayed to the customer and they'll accept the terms out-of-band. After this step the flow will need to do a customer eligibility check if required.

nodes.confidential_notes: This is an eligibility record, not a billing record.
nodes.name: createCustomer
nodes.text: createCustomer: Call the BNPL platform and verify the customer is eligible for the loan, which creates a customer resource. This step is skipped if the customer is already enrolled in the BNPL platform. Accepting the terms and conditions is set to true as the assumption is they have been accepted when this step is invoked. If the customer is eligible for the BNPL loan then a customer resource is created

nodes.name: initiateBnplTransaction

outputs.source: LINT-01: derived, not declared by the step

nodes.text: initiateBnplTransaction: Initiate the BNPL transaction by sending the customer identifier, eligible products, and indicative loan amount to initiate the loan process

nodes.confidential_notes: Authentication vendor and challenge policy are confidential.
nodes.name: authenticateCustomerAndAuthorizeLoan
nodes.text: authenticateCustomerAndAuthorizeLoan: Authenticate the customer and seek authorization for the loan. Notes: - Authenticate in this case does not necessarily mean with a valid set of credentials. It could be to prove the identity of the end user, possibly doing an UMA style interaction (which is too complex to tie into this example). - A redirect is returned for to be sent to the customer. The customer should follow this, but the success of the authorisation is out-of-band. - This flow mimics OAuth style authorization but is not an exact match as it does not rely on an authorisation code/access token exchange (as this seems somewhat artificial in this context).

nodes.name: retrieveFinalizedPaymentPlan
nodes.text: retrieveFinalizedPaymentPlan: Retrieve finalized payment plan to show to customer once authorization is complete

nodes.name: updateOrderStatus
nodes.text: updateOrderStatus: Send update from eCommerce platform to indicate order fulfilled and loan is therefore active

nodes.name: END_not_eligible
nodes.text: END_not_eligible: terminal outcome not_eligible. The merchant must be allowed to see a decline.

nodes.name: decide_eligibilityCheckRequired
nodes.text: decide_eligibilityCheckRequired: branch on eligibilityCheckRequired after getCustomerTermsAndConditions: eligibilityCheckRequired / eligibilityCheckNotRequired

nodes.name: decide_redirectAuthToken
nodes.text: decide_redirectAuthToken: branch on redirectAuthToken after initiateBnplTransaction: CustomerAuthorizationRequired / CustomerAuthorizationNotRequired
